title: The Elves and the Shoemaker
summary: A poor shoemaker finds new shoes in his shop every morning, and he wants to know who makes them.

source.work: Grimm's Fairy Tales (Kinder- und Hausmärchen), "The Elves"
source.author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm
source.note: Retold from the plot of the tale in new A2 English by Lexkite; no sentences copied from any translation.

chapters.title: The Last Piece of Leather
sentences: Once upon a time, there was a poor shoemaker.
He worked hard every day, but he had very little money.
One evening, he had only one piece of leather left.
He cut it carefully and put it on his table.
"I will make the shoes tomorrow morning," he said to his wife.
Then he went to bed and slept.
In the morning, he could not believe his eyes.
There was a beautiful pair of shoes on the table.
Every stitch was small and perfect.
Soon a rich customer came into the shop.
He liked the shoes so much that he paid a high price.
Now the shoemaker had enough money for more leather.

quiz.q: What did the shoemaker leave on the table?
quiz.explain: He cut his last piece of leather and left it on the table to work on in the morning.

quiz.q: Why was the shoemaker surprised in the morning?
options: He found beautiful shoes that he did not make.
quiz.explain: Someone made a perfect pair of shoes while he was asleep.

quiz.q: What did the shoemaker do with the money?
options: He gave it to the customer.
quiz.explain: The high price gave him enough money for more leather.

chapters.title: Thank You, Little Friends
sentences: This happened every night for many weeks.
The shoemaker and his wife were not poor anymore.
One night before Christmas, his wife had an idea.
"Let's stay awake and see who helps us," she said.
They hid behind a curtain in the corner of the room.
At midnight, two tiny elves came in.
Their clothes were old, and they had no shoes.
The elves sat at the table and worked very fast.
When the shoes were ready, they ran away.
The next day, the wife made small shirts and coats.
The shoemaker made two pairs of tiny shoes.
That night, the elves found the presents and put them on.
They danced happily and never came back.
But the shoemaker was lucky for the rest of his life.

quiz.q: Where did the shoemaker and his wife hide?
quiz.explain: They hid behind a curtain in the corner of the room.

quiz.q: Why did the wife make clothes for the elves?
options: The elves had old clothes and no shoes.
quiz.explain: She saw that the elves' clothes were old and they had no shoes, so she wanted to thank them.

quiz.q: What happened after the elves got the presents?
options: They danced and never came back.
quiz.explain: The elves were happy, danced, and did not come back.
